mapper.sql: SELECT ds.id, ds.device_id, ds.device_code, ds.sensor_code, ds.sensor_name, ds.monitor_type_id, ds.monitor_type_code, ds.monitor_type_name, ds.burial_depth, ds.status, ds.del_flag, ds.create_by, ds.create_time, ds.update_by, ds.update_time, mt.icon AS monitor_type_icon FROM device_sensor ds LEFT JOIN monitor_type mt ON ds.monitor_type_id = mt.id
mapper.select: WHERE ds.device_id = #{deviceId} AND ds.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY ds.id ASC
WHERE ds.device_id = #{deviceId} AND ds.sensor_code = #{sensorCode} AND ds.del_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_sensor WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_sensor( device_id, device_code, sensor_code, sensor_name, monitor_type_id, monitor_type_code, monitor_type_name, burial_depth, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{deviceId}, #{deviceCode}, #{sensorCode}, #{sensorName}, #{monitorTypeId}, #{monitorTypeCode}, #{monitorTypeName}, #{burialDepth}, #{status}, #{createBy}, SYSDATE() )

device_code = #{deviceCode}, sensor_name = #{sensorName}, monitor_type_id = #{monitorTypeId}, monitor_type_code = #{monitorTypeCode}, monitor_type_name = #{monitorTypeName}, burial_depth = #{burialDepth}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = SYSDATE()

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_sensor WHERE del_flag = 0
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM device_sensor WHERE del_flag = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT ds.monitor_type_id AS monitorTypeId, mt.name AS monitorTypeName, COALESCE(mt.sort_order, 999) AS sortOrder, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM device_sensor ds INNER JOIN monitor_type mt ON ds.monitor_type_id = mt.id AND mt.del_flag = 0 WHERE ds.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY ds.monitor_type_id, mt.name, mt.sort_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_sensor WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status = 1 AND last_report_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowMinutes} MINUTE)

SELECT ds.monitor_type_id AS monitorTypeId, mt.name AS monitorTypeName, COALESCE(mt.sort_order, 999) AS sortOrder, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(CASE WHEN dos.status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS online FROM device_sensor ds INNER JOIN monitor_type mt ON ds.monitor_type_id = mt.id AND mt.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN device d ON ds.device_id = d.id AND d.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN device_online_status dos ON d.id = dos.device_id WHERE ds.del_flag = 0 AND ds.status = 1 GROUP BY ds.monitor_type_id, mt.name, mt.sort_order

SELECT ds.monitor_type_id AS monitorTypeId, mt.name AS monitorTypeName, COALESCE(mt.sort_order, 999) AS sortOrder, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(CASE WHEN ds.last_report_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowMinutes} MINUTE) THEN 1 END) AS active FROM device_sensor ds INNER JOIN monitor_type mt ON ds.monitor_type_id = mt.id AND mt.del_flag = 0 WHERE ds.del_flag = 0 AND ds.status = 1 GROUP BY ds.monitor_type_id, mt.name, mt.sort_order
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ds.id) FROM device_sensor ds INNER JOIN device_online_status os ON ds.device_id = os.device_id WHERE ds.del_flag = 0 AND ds.status = 1 AND os.status = 1
